KeyError: 'customer_email'

workflow_definition.name: Invoice Customer Dispatcher
workflow_definition.description: Dispatches monthly PDF invoices to customer email address upon billing cycle close.

remediation_options.title: Update Workflow Field Mapping
remediation_options.description: Update invoice workflow step 3 to consume 'email' field instead of 'customer_email'.
remediation_options.trade_offs: Immediate fix localized to invoice workflow; requires updating any other consumers if they also rely on customer_email.

remediation_options.title: Restore Backward-Compatible Alias in Backend API
remediation_options.description: Expose both 'email' and 'customer_email' (deprecated alias) in customer service API response.
remediation_options.trade_offs: Preserves backward compatibility for all consumers; leaves deprecated alias in API contract until scheduled retirement.

remediation_options.title: Restart Workflow Execution Worker
remediation_options.description: Restart the workflow engine worker pods without code or schema changes.
remediation_options.trade_offs: Does not address root cause; workflow will fail immediately upon next attempt.
